title: Placeholder-only labels
summary: Using placeholder text as the only visible label makes a field's purpose disappear as soon as the user types and weakens accessibility.
problem: Users must remember field meaning after entry, and placeholders are often lower contrast or inconsistently announced.
use_when: Auditing text inputs where the placeholder carries the only field name
avoid_when: A persistent visible label already exists and the placeholder is only a nonessential example
rationale: Examples and labels serve different purposes.

signals: input has placeholder but no persistent visible label
placeholder contains field name needed after typing
